notes: Bestor Plaza memorial fountain: four shallow stone allegories with their identifying attributes and inscriptions, ART (palette and brush), RELIGION (bearded figure holding tablet), KNOWLEDGE (torch and scroll), MUSIC (lyre). Native fountain renderer provides fluted corner pilasters, palmette frieze and stepped crown. Preserve the existing 11 m square basin, 4.9 m height and four corner jets. Art/Religion adjacency follows the supplied corner reference; absolute compass assignments are not established by the unlocated close-up photographs. Four corner statuettes are carved fish with raised heads, forked tails, fins and overlapping scales; each open mouth is aligned to its inward water jet. Water, coping, pylon and fish structure are retained in coarse streaming scenery.
